result.title: Adaptive Quantization Preserves Fast Rates for TD Learning over Rate-Limited Channels
result.summary: Motivated by reinforcement learning subject to communication constraints, we study a policy evaluation problem with linear function approximation over a rate-limited channel. In our setup, an agent interacting with an unknown environment (modeled as a Markov Decision Process) transmits quantized estimates of a temporal-difference (TD) learning update direction to a server over a finite-capacity channel. Our goal is to investigate to what extent one can preserve the statistical convergence rates achievable when the channel has infinite capacity. To that end, we propose a new algorithm called Batched Adaptively Quantized TD (BAQ-TD), which uses batching to reduce the variance of the transmitted information, and adaptive quantization to encode innovations. We prove a high-probability finite-time error bound for BAQ-TD, and show that, above a certain finite channel capacity, BAQ-TD preserves the convergence rate of unquantized TD up to logarithmic factors. Specifically, for a $d$-dimensional value function parameter, we establish that transmitting a total of $\mathcal{O}(d \log(T))$ bits over a horizon of length $T$ suffices to achieve the order-optimal rate of $\tilde{\mathcal{O}}(1/T)$, marking an exponential improvement in communication-complexity over prior work.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文研究限速信道下的策略评估：智能体只向服务器传输 TD 更新方向的量化估计，提出批量自适应量化算法 BAQ-TD，并给出高概率有限时间误差界，证明在有限信道容量之上仍可保持无量化 TD 的收敛速率与 O(d log T) 比特的通信量。
AI.relevance_reason: 与视觉推理无直接关联，但其「自适应量化增量 + 批量降方差」以及比特预算与收敛速率的权衡，可能为 LVR 中 latent 状态的精度、压缩与传递成本问题提供可核查的表述与分析工具。
